decisions.title: Producer serialization
decisions.source_confirmed: Certifier Package v1.1 canonical; toolkit JSON generated-artifact schema exists but is not independently approved exchange contract
decisions.required: Adopt a source-owned machine payload/identifier, schema/version, issuer provenance, current state access and archival format
decisions.proof: Exact pinned approved producer interface and origin-authorized sample plus negative/unknown behavior

decisions.title: Receiving Registry intake
decisions.source_confirmed: SREG Base Schema and certification profile are output shape; governance defines decision authority separately
decisions.required: Approve recipient intake schema/API, operation, role, refusal classifications, request-to-SREG construction boundary
decisions.proof: Approved Registry receiving contract with effective rule and nonproduction operating scope

decisions.title: Status, version, lifecycle
decisions.source_confirmed: Historical source v1.1, SREG v1.0 and permitted published code; machine controlled-values JSON publishes only registry_status active
decisions.required: Approve separate historical/current source version resolution; lifecycle code/label vocabulary, effective transition rules, no status collapse
decisions.proof: Versioned Registry and Certifier decisions and controlled-values/transition crosswalk

decisions.title: Predicate authority
decisions.source_confirmed: Native SREG registers relationship has Registry authority; Suite predicate review is distinct
decisions.required: Approve if/how native registers is represented in any separate Suite envelope without synonym substitution
decisions.proof: Directionality, evidence strength, owner, allowed predicate namespaces and inverse-mapping policy

decisions.title: Authentication and audit
decisions.source_confirmed: Registry governance permits documented approved controls, not any assumed caller credential
decisions.required: Approved principal, receiver authorization checks, trace, refusal, durable idempotency and readback; no automatic write
decisions.proof: Owner-signed governance/policy decision and independent nonproduction enforcement evidence

decisions.title: Representation parity
decisions.source_confirmed: Canonical human-readable SREG and record.json preserve registry/source status and versions
decisions.required: Plan independent read-only parity/currentness/history tests with effective source/object SHA and correction lineage
decisions.proof: Executed source-authoritative/read-only parity report with timestamp, issuer version and Registry owner verification

approval_questions.question: Which canonical current package machine representation and status/version namespace does Certifier expressly adopt for prospective reference consumers?
approval_questions.must_not_assume: Toolkit sample/schema alone is approved issuer wire format

approval_questions.question: What Registry-owned intake method, receiving decision and refusal policy applies to certification source records?
approval_questions.must_not_assume: SREG output profile creates an endpoint or permits external issuance

approval_questions.question: Which machine lifecycle values, code/label pair rules and transitions are controlling, and how is historical published represented?
approval_questions.must_not_assume: Prose Active and schema published are synonyms

approval_questions.question: Does the native registers relationship need any second Suite-normalized representation, with which direction and authority?
approval_questions.must_not_assume: Suite references is a synonym for native registers

approval_questions.question: Which authenticated principal, explicit approval and durable readback are required for one nonproduction attempt?
approval_questions.must_not_assume: Access, reported success or a synthetic trace confers approval

approval_questions.question: What evidence confirms historical and current source/SREG representation parity and version-safe corrections?
approval_questions.must_not_assume: Stored source v1.1 proves live currentness
